recorded: Every case passed against the original with Node.js 26.12.1, tsx 4.23.1, @langchain/core 1.1.19, @langchain/langgraph 1.2.0, @langchain/mcp-adapters 1.1.3, @langchain/openai 1.2.5, langchain 1.2.18, and fastify 5.7.4, run as "node --import tsx src/index.ts" without a .env file. npm start runs the same file with Node.js type stripping, which stops with a SyntaxError on Node.js 24.10 and 26 because the template imports the ChatGeneration type as a value, so the copy that produced these cases installed tsx without saving it, which drops that import, and no file was patched. The template calls no model, so the cases replay nothing. The entry point always listens on port 3000, which must be free, and its output is deterministic.
